_comment: Dedup ledger for the kirana-daily-posts autopilot routine. Replaces conversation_search (unavailable in scheduled runs). BEFORE drafting, read this and avoid anything used within dedup_window_days. AFTER a successful submit, append today's run. Keep newest-first. TRENDING THEME COOLDOWN: trending_1_theme/trending_2_theme carry canonical theme tags; any evergreen theme used in the last 7 days (scam, monsoon-weather, fmcg-price, fuel-economy, agri-commodity, supply-chain, etc.) is BANNED for the next run — compare by theme tag, not topic sentence. This is what prevents repeat scam/monsoon. Both *_theme fields are mandatory on every new run.

runs.trending_2: सावन 30 जुलाई से 28 अगस्त + कांवड़ यात्रा 30 जुलाई से - व्रत/फलाहार सामान (सेंधा नमक, कुट्टू आटा, समक चावल, साबूदाना) की मांग; अभी स्टॉक करने का मौका
runs.scheme: डाकघर मासिक आय योजना (POMIS) - अकेले 9 लाख/जॉइंट 15 लाख तक जमा, ~7.4% ब्याज हर महीने, 5 साल
runs._note: Posted for 9 जुलाई using VK-08-July-2026 paper (डाक 09 जुलाई). Normal same-day run (fetch ~11:24 AM IST, before 7:30PM cutoff -> targeted today). Banned themes (fuel-economy/monsoon-weather/tech/ondc-online/fmcg-price/new-product/store-growth/raid-bust) avoided; picked upi-payment + festival-demand (both net-positive). soya direction तेजी repeats 07-08 but is data-driven (PDF: oils up on falling mustard arrivals + soya DOC 61k) - not fabricated. Samachar hero=मसाले/धनिया, chosen fresh to avoid reusing 07-07 gold-hero or 07-08 oils-hero.
